note: Single source of truth for the layer rules. Consumed by .claude/hooks/brick_check.py and the /brick-check command. Change limits HERE, nowhere else. Regexes deliberately use [x] character classes instead of backslash escapes so they survive JSON encoding unambiguously.

layers.role: Pure analysis rules: AAS element model as the analysis sees it, semanticId scheme classification, statistics, finding/violation types. No I/O.
Protocols only. No implementations, no logic.
Use-cases: run an analysis over a corpus, assemble a report. Orchestrates domain through ports.
Everything that touches the outside world. One sub-package per external concern (neo4aas parsing, PostgreSQL, schema validation, file reading, templates, report output, web).
Settings (PostgreSQL connection, upload limits, ...), read and validated once at startup.
Composition root. The ONLY module allowed to construct adapters and wire them to use-cases.

pureLayerNote: A pure layer may import the standard library except the I/O modules above, plus its allowed aaspect layers. Any third-party package (psycopg, neo4aas, lxml, ...) is I/O or a technology choice and belongs behind a port.

budgets.functionLocExemptNote: The function-length budget detects a sequence of unnamed steps hiding inside one function. A test class groups many small independent cases; splitting it would scatter related tests for no gain. Security rules, layering and file size still apply to tests.

forbidden.reason: SQL is never built by string formatting: not the query passed to run/execute/copy, not the text of a psycopg sql.SQL. Identifiers and values from uploaded AAS files would become injection. Pass values as query parameters; compose SQL identifiers with psycopg.sql.Identifier inside sql.SQL(...).format(...).
Database credentials (a password literal, a connection URL with a password) come from config/environment, never from a literal in code.

escapeHatch.note: Append `# arch-allow: <written reason>` to the offending line to override a blocking rule. The written reason is required and shows up in review.
